name: Adobe Firefly Services — Core
description: Shared foundation for Adobe Firefly Services: IMS OAuth Server-to-Server token provider (cached), a base REST client (x-api-key + bearer, retry, timeout), the async job port (polling or webhook), a presigned-URL storage seam (passthrough default), and Adobe error classification. Service addons require this and add one port + adapter each.

questions.prompt: How do async jobs report completion?

checklist: Create an Adobe Developer Console project and add the Firefly Services / API entitlement
Generate OAuth Server-to-Server credentials; set ADOBE_CLIENT_ID / ADOBE_CLIENT_SECRET / ADOBE_SCOPES in .env.local
Do NOT use JWT — the Service-Account/JWT flow is retired. @adobe/jwt-auth is not used; this is Server-to-Server (client_credentials)
Confirm your entitlement covers the specific service addons you install — scopes differ per service
If job_mode=webhook: expose the receiver route publicly and set ADOBE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (the verifier fails closed without it)

Webhook mode parks completion promises IN MEMORY — correct only for a single long-lived instance. On serverless / multi-instance deploys use polling, or back jobPort's registry with a shared store (Redis/BullMQ, Postgres)
Smoke the token flow: npx tsx src/infrastructure/adobe/auth/smoke-token.ts
infrastructure/adobe/** is @hexagen-server-only — never import it from a client bundle (it holds the IMS token)
